description: Rows from one official Saudi register as this platform last mirrored it. register: sppc (Saudi Power Procurement Company, the Principal Buyer — every solar and wind project with its contracted capacity in MW and status connected|construction), swpc (Saudi Water Partnership Company / SHARAKAT — independent desalination, sewage treatment, transmission and strategic storage projects with capacity, regions, commercial operation year, contract model and published tariff; status operation|construction|tendering|planning), swa (Saudi Water Authority open-data catalogue — every dataset the authority publishes, with formats and resource counts; these rows carry no status). Use this rather than a tracker when the question is what the publisher itself lists.

status.description: Match one status exactly, case-insensitive. The swa catalogue carries none.

name: get_register
title: Official register rows
